output.title: nodeSelector quoting fix: no nodeSelector key among the supplied values
output.content: The release note says only that v1.18.0 quotes nodeSelector values in the Helm chart (#7579). None of the 9 values keys shown sets a nodeSelector: they are global.leaderElection.namespace, global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole, prometheus.servicemonitor.*, replicaCount and webhook.timeoutSeconds. However, the values dimension is marked partial. This chart is deployed through a Flux HelmRelease, an Argo CD Application and helmfile, so values from those sources may not all have been supplied. Check every values source for any nodeSelector setting in the cert-manager chart; if none sets one, this fix does not touch your rendered manifests.
